name: cc-star-skills
description: Kam Star's Claude Code plugins: multi-session build planning (roadmap/calibrate-roadmap/session/wrapup/handoff/autopilot/archive-roadmap), an embedded-AI-copilot build wizard, narrated product films and tours for any web app (showcase), user guides written from a walk of the app, then illustrated and published to Confluence or HTML (user-guides), and read-only audits of a web platform from the user's side, mapping every screen, field and feature (audit).

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Multi-session build planning skills (roadmap, calibrate-roadmap, session, wrapup, handoff, autopilot, archive-roadmap).

plugins.name: copilot
plugins.description: Interactive wizard that builds an embedded, tool-calling AI copilot into an existing web app (build-copilot).

plugins.name: showcase
plugins.description: Interview-led wizard that makes a narrated, captioned, verified product film of any web app from one tour file, plus a self-playing live demo and an in-app guided tour (showcase).

plugins.name: user-guides
plugins.description: Write a web app's end-user guides from a walk of the running app as each role, then screenshot them and publish them to Confluence Data Center or self-contained HTML; after a release, refresh and republish only what changed (write-guides, wiki-guides).

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: Audit a web platform from the user's side: walk the signed-in app read-only and slowly in your own Chrome, read its public JavaScript as text for what the screens can't show, and write a report of every screen, field and feature, with an appendix of UI labels (platform-audit).
